offers.description: Available as an individual service pick ($100 USD for individuals / $200 USD for businesses, each for 5 days of live training + 5 days of dedicated support, 10 days total coverage), or as part of our comprehensive programs: Business Training ($2,000 USD for 40 days: 20d training + 20d guidance/materials, up to 20 seats, +$100/extra seat) or Personal Training ($1,000 USD for 40 days: 20d training + 20d guidance/materials, 1 person only). Clients are free to pick and choose their services. Full 195-country Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) supported across all service pricing.
